verdict.rationale: Superset is an agent-orchestration workspace tool, so issue triage is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence shows a native capability that automatically triages incoming issues, suggests severity, or routes them to an owner. The SDK note about scripting 'triage' of tasks and the scheduled automations are developer building blocks a user could assemble into such a flow, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner
